promise: Your score, your biggest gap, and one plan to close it this week.
need: An honest look at how your business runs today
Claude or ChatGPT (free or paid) for the last step
forTech: The test is a scored self-audit across the 12 jobs an AI-first business hands to agents, split by business type. Your lowest area is your constraint, so you work on that one first.
intro: Every week someone posts that AI changed everything for them. You read it and wonder: am I ahead, or am I behind? You can't tell, because nobody gave you anything to measure against.

So I built a test. It scores you against the 12 jobs I see an AI-first business hand to agents. I run those jobs with agents every day in my own business. September did $83K and October did $90K, with one person.
The name is simple. If business keeps moving toward AI, how ready is yours for 2028? You get a score, your biggest gap, and the next move for your business type.

body: It's live and it's free. Open it with the button on this page.

steps.title: Pick your business type
steps.text: Choose the type closest to how you earn money right now. Your questions and your next move change with it.

steps.title: Answer for today
steps.text: Answer for how your business runs this week. Not how you plan to run it, and not how it ran on your best week.
steps.why: A kind score is a useless score. Nobody sees it but you.

steps.title: Save your result
steps.text: Write down 3 things from your result: your score, your biggest gap, and the next move it gives you. You'll use all 3 below.

body: The score is a snapshot of today. It isn't a grade on you. A low score with one clear gap is a good result, because you know where to work.
The biggest gap is the part that matters. It's the one job that holds the rest back. Close that one and the others get easier.
The next move is the first small step for your business type. Do that before anything else. Don't try to fix all 12 jobs. Fix 1.
Your result names your gap in its own words. Find the closest line here and open that free guide in the training library.
You don't know which agents you need: Your AI Org Chart.
You're scared AI will break what already works: Before You Let AI Touch Your Business.
Comments and DMs sit there with no answer: Comment to Customer.
Leads go quiet because nobody follows up: 15 Emails That Sell While You Sleep.
New clients take too long to get started: Onboard a New Client in 10 Minutes.
AI says it's done and it isn't: Done Means Checked.
Every chat starts from zero: The Shared Brain.
You can't tell if any of it made money: Did AI Make You Money This Month?

steps.title: Turn your gap into a 7-day plan
steps.text: Paste this into Claude or ChatGPT with your own result filled in.
steps.copy:
I took a test that scores how ready my business is to run with AI agents.

My score: [your score]
My biggest gap: [paste it]
The next move it gave me: [paste it]
My business in one line: [what you sell and who buys it]

Give me a 7-day plan to close this one gap. One small task a day, 30 minutes or less. Start with the next move above. Before you write the plan, ask me one question at a time about the tools I already use.
steps.why: One gap and one week is a plan you'll finish.

steps.title: Take it again in 30 days
steps.text: Set a reminder. Take the test again and compare the 2 scores. That's your proof that the work moved something.

eureka: I don't have to catch up on all of AI. I have to close one gap, then the next one.
check: You have your score, your biggest gap and your next move written down
You opened the one free guide that matches your gap
You have a 7-day plan with one small task a day
You set a reminder to take the test again in 30 days
limits: The test shows where you stand. It doesn't build anything.
The score comes from your own answers. It can't check your systems for you.
The 7-day plan is a starter for 1 gap. It doesn't set up agents that do the work every day.

diy.line: Open the free guide that matches your gap. If you're not sure which one, start with Your AI Org Chart and see your agents job by job.

dwy.line: A Strategy Call is 60 minutes with me to go through your result and leave with a strategy for AI to build and run your business.

dfy.line: The Seven Star Build closes every gap at once: your whole revenue system merged and run by agents, by my own hands. Builds start with the Discovery Call.
